name: cdna4_mfma_hazard_audit
description: Three CDNA4 (gfx950) hazard classes that produce silent wrong-output in MFMA-heavy asm kernels. Audit checklist + fingerprints + fixes.
preconditions: hand-written asm kernel with v_mfma_f32_32x32x16_bf16 or similar
kernel compiles cleanly but produces wrong runtime output
steps: Hazard 1 (VGPR collision): identify every VGPR set up in prolog as per-lane address; verify it is NOT written in K-loop body. Fingerprint: works on iter 1, fails iter 2+. Fix: relocate transient (e.g., alpha) to dedicated scratch VGPR like v126.

Hazard 2 (MFMA->MFMA C-operand race): two consecutive v_mfma writing same a[X:Y] with intervening VALU/LDS need explicit cooldown. Fingerprint: a16..a19 of lanes 0..3 contain wrong values; other AGPRs/lanes correct. Fix: s_nop 15 x 2 = 30 cyc between MFMAs, OR overlap with productive LDS reads + s_nop 7 (Phase 1c pattern).

Hazard 3 (v_rcp/v_exp -> v_mul read-after-write): v_rcp_f32 or v_exp_f32 immediately followed by v_mul reading the result reads STALE value. Fingerprint: garbage = unrelated_register x intended_multiplicand, often a 'clean' factorization like -5909.28 = -184.66 x 32 = -m_new x log2e x divisor. Fix: s_nop 4 between v_rcp/v_exp and the dependent v_mul.
Math-back debugging: when seeing garbage value X, try to factorize. Recognize log2(e) = 1.4427, sqrt(2) = 1.414, etc. Often localizes to a specific stale-register multiplication hazard.

Parallel agent review (for non-trivial cases): spawn 2-3 reviewers with distinct focuses (timing/math/layout) in single message with run_in_background. ~2 min to find 3 orthogonal bugs vs hours serial.
expected_impact: correctness: silent wrong-output -> validated. Found 3 hazard bugs in week4n_mvp FMHA fwd kernel that each caused subtle wrong output for varying input data.
success_contexts: asm_vsa_fwd week4n_mvp: identified v77 alpha clobber, MFMA1->MFMA2 a[16:31] race, v_rcp->v_mul stale-v78 = -5909.28 garbage. All fixed via the 3 prescribed fixes.

decision_rules.if: MFMA kernel produces wrong output but assembles cleanly
decision_rules.then: run this audit BEFORE deeper investigation; bug is likely one of the 3 classes

decision_rules.if: wrong output is data-dependent (works for V=1.0, fails for V varying)
decision_rules.then: Hazard 1 (VGPR collision in K-loop) is most likely

decision_rules.if: garbage is in specific AGPR + lane subset only (e.g., a16..a19 of lanes 0..3)
garbage factorizes cleanly (e.g., contains log2(e) or sqrt(2))
decision_rules.then: Hazard 3 (rcp/exp -> mul race); audit epilog v_mul ordering
